items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think there was a son, Paul – and Nelson.

ctx.x: Yes. I had a couple of cousins, but I don’t – we didn’t keep a close contact with each other, ever. I recall there was two girls and there was two boys. I think there was a son, Paul – and Nelson. Paul and Nelson were the two boys I recall. I think there was two girls on that side from my father’s brother, but there wasn’t much contact. Anything you want to say? I didn’t hear you. Devra Hall Levy: No. I’m ready to move North. Do you want the names of things before you start?
